newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan electricity demand rises 2.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan electricity demand rises 2.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Demand for electricity supplied by nine Japanese power utilities rose 2.7 percent in January from a year earlier to 69.0 billion kilowatt hours (kWh), the Federation of Electric Power Companies said on Monday.
Electricity consumption by large-lot industrial users grew 4.4 percent, marking a year-on-year rise for the fifth consecutive month, the federation said.
The growth was largely due to increased use by electrical and transport machinery makers and steel producers, it said.
Electricity used by households rose 2.4 percent in January from a year earlier, while consumption in offices grew by 2.9 percent, the federation said.
